newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - July 11.

text.p: The Washington Post included the following stories on its front page on Friday:

SARAJEVO - NATO troops shot dead a senior Bosnian Serb police officer wanted for genocide and seized another Bosnian Serb on the same charges in the first NATO operation to arrest Bosnians accused of war crimes.
WASHINGTON - R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Co announced that it is retiring Joe Camel, ending one of the cigarette industry's most criticised advertising campaigns.
WASHINGTON - The operation aimed at capturing two suspected war criminals in Bosnia has its roots in a secret change of tactics made by NATO nearly four months ago.

PHNOM PENH - Cambodia's Second Prime Minister Hun Sen denied that the bloody weekend military operation ousting of his main rival, First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh, from power was a coup and said his target was Khmer Rouge guerrilla fighters infiltrated into the capital.
WASHINGTON - Neanderthals were not close relatives or even ancestral forms of existing humans, a new study has found.
LONDON - British huntsmen gathered at Hyde Park to protest a bill that would put an end to traditional fox hunting.
WASHINGTON - Senators investigating campaign finance abuse were still scrambling for answers and not finding any at the end of their first week of hearings.
